No. PMEGP/UdhyamReg./01/2023 dated 07.12.2023. This O.M. SUPERSEDES the May 2022 O.M. (IN-MSME-2022-0001) and makes Udyam Registration mandatory for all new PMEGP units before physical verification and margin money adjustment. This is the MOST RECENT PMEGP guideline modification and represents the current operational baseline. Key clause: 'All new units setup under PMEGP will be mandatorily registered under Udyam Portal before Physical Verification of the Unit and the adjustment of the Margin Money.' The 15th Finance Commission cycle (2021-22 to 2025-26) and Rs. 13,554.42 Crore outlay remain unchanged.
